title: Officials asked whether he had a mental connection to the triangle

tellings.quote: when I came forward, they were very interested if I had a connection to the triangle.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who came forward with claims about unexplained craft, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that when he went to the government, officials were very interested in whether he had a mental connection to something he calls "the triangle." If true, it would mean officials took seriously the idea that a person could be linked to such an object by the mind.
